documents.title: Minimum Attendance Requirement
documents.content: Students must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in each course to be eligible to appear for the semester examination.

documents.title: Semester Exam Registration
documents.content: The last date for semester exam registration is 15th September 2026. Late registration with a fine is allowed until 20th September 2026.

documents.title: Placement Drive Eligibility
documents.content: Students with a CGPA of 6.5 or above and no active backlogs are eligible to register for the campus placement drive.

history.question: How much attendance do I need to maintain?
history.answer: According to Regulation "Minimum Attendance Requirement": Students must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in each course to be eligible to appear for the semester examination.

history.question: Am I eligible for the placement drive?
history.answer: According to Placement "Placement Drive Eligibility": Students with a CGPA of 6.5 or above and no active backlogs are eligible to register for the campus placement drive.
